frozen_collection.source: private custom-json-v1 deterministic local helper contract

validate_source.command: uv run --frozen nl2repo task validate-source catalog/sources/ghapi

lint_network.command: uv run --frozen nl2repo task lint-network --tasks-root catalog/sources

production_compile.command: uv run --frozen nl2repo harbor compile catalog/sources/ghapi --output .nl2repo/final-compile-a --toolchain toolchain.lock.toml --artifact-root .nl2repo/artifacts --allow-private

oracle.command: uv run --frozen --project harbor-runner harbor run -p .nl2repo/final-compile-a/ghapi -a oracle --allow-agent-host github.com --job-name ghapi-oracle-handoff-20260828 -o .nl2repo/runs/ghapi-oracle-handoff-20260828 --n-concurrent 1 --yes

stub.command: uv run --frozen nl2repo harbor prepare-control .nl2repo/final-compile-a/ghapi stub --output .nl2repo/controls/ghapi/stub --toolchain toolchain.lock.toml && uv run --frozen --project harbor-runner harbor run -p .nl2repo/controls/ghapi/stub/ghapi-stub -a oracle --job-name ghapi-stub-handoff-20260828 -o .nl2repo/runs/ghapi-stub-handoff-20260828 --n-concurrent 1 --yes

forgery.command: uv run --frozen nl2repo harbor prepare-control .nl2repo/final-compile-a/ghapi forgery --output .nl2repo/controls/ghapi/forgery --toolchain toolchain.lock.toml && uv run --frozen --project harbor-runner harbor run -p .nl2repo/controls/ghapi/forgery/ghapi-forgery -a oracle --job-name ghapi-forgery-handoff-20260828 -o .nl2repo/runs/ghapi-forgery-handoff-20260828 --n-concurrent 1 --yes

offline.note: The available Harbor control CLI supports only stub and forgery; both controls and the Oracle verifier emitted no-network receipts. No unrun empty-control result is claimed.
